purpose: Let the assistant drive the game's own menus headlessly (user order via team lead 2026-09-01). Immediate need: open the Creations/Creation Club menu and trigger the re-download of the owned Farming creation whose ccvsvsse004-beafarmer.bsa was truncated (#142). File-based command bridge, VT2 console-bridge shape: assistant writes commands.jsonl, plugin consumes exactly once, results append to a flushed log.

commonLibSSE.pinEnforced: CMake fails unless COMMONLIB_SSE_FOLDER is a git checkout at that exact revision

build.toolchain: Identical to ensrick-launch-probe.json (Ninja + MSVC 19.44, x64-windows-static, RelWithDebInfo, /MT, IPO, C++23) plus vcpkg nlohmann-json for command parsing.

behavior.logPathResolution: SHGetKnownFolderPath(FOLDERID_Documents), fixed real path outside the VFS - LaunchProbe rationale
behavior.lineFormat: [YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.mmm] +<ms since DLL attach> EVENT key=value key="quoted"
behavior.flush: fflush after every line; opened _wfsopen _SH_DENYWR so the harness can tail live
behavior.consumeOnce: commands.jsonl is renamed to commands-<n>-working.jsonl BEFORE any byte is read; archived as commands-<n>-<stamp>-done.jsonl after the batch
behavior.mainThreadDispatch: poll thread (started at kInputLoaded, default 250ms, SKYRIM_MENU_PILOT_POLL_MS) hops every op onto SKSE::GetTaskInterface()->AddTask and waits up to 30s
behavior.inputSynthesis: RE::ButtonEvent::Create + BSInputDeviceManager (BSTEventSource<InputEvent*>) SendEvent on the main thread - the same channel real device input takes to MenuControls; OS focus irrelevant. Events deliberately leaked (~0x30B each): ~ButtonEvent has no definition in the clib pin.
behavior.safety: inert without a command file; every command echoed to the log before execution; panic halts all ops except ping/resume and kHides pilot-opened menus; no MessageBox ever (own-IAT stubs)
behavior.noPopups: Same IAT patch as LaunchProbe, scoped to MenuPilot.dll's own user32 imports

apisVerified.buttonEvent: RE::ButtonEvent::Create(INPUT_DEVICE, BSFixedString userEvent, idCode, value, heldSecs) - include/RE/B/ButtonEvent.h:36; BSInputDeviceManager is BSTEventSource<InputEvent*> (include/RE/B/BSInputDeviceManager.h:26)
apisVerified.creationClubMenu: RE::CreationClubMenu MENU_NAME="Creation Club Menu", IMenu+MenuEventHandler+GFxFunctionHandler over creationclub.swf - include/RE/C/CreationClubMenu.h

installation.note: mods/MenuPilot/SKSE/Plugins/{MenuPilot.dll,MenuPilot.pdb} + meta.ini; +MenuPilot added to modlist.txt directly below +LaunchProbe via Python while ModOrganizer.exe was not running.

verified: Clean configure+build against the exact CommonLibSSE-NG pin, 0 warnings 0 errors (first pass).
skse_version_data.py PASS (version independent), same gate shape as LaunchProbe.
Every API used was read out of the pinned clib headers (paths above), not assumed.
notVerified: Runtime behaviour pending the 2026-09-01 pilot test launch - see records/menupilot-cc-discovery-2026-09-01.log and the changelog entry for outcomes.

distribution.status: private instrumentation; not for redistribution. Links CommonLibSSE-NG (GPL-3.0-or-later).
